skill.name: gsap-scrolltrigger
skill.description: Scroll-based animations using GSAP ScrollTrigger plugin including pinning, scrubbing, snap points, and parallax effects. Use when creating scroll-driven animations, sticky sections, progress indicators, or parallax scrolling experiences.

generated_query:
I'm redesigning my portfolio site and want to add scroll-driven animations to make it more engaging. Specifically, I need:

- A hero section where the background image moves upward slower than the text (parallax) as the user scrolls.
- A "skills" section that pins itself at the top while each skill bar fills from 0% to its target width when it scrolls into view.
- A timeline of work experience where each entry fades in and slides up as the user scrolls, with smooth scrubbing so the progress follows the scroll position exactly.
- A horizontal gallery at the bottom that scrolls horizontally while pinned, snapping to each image as the user stops scrolling.

I'm using React and have already installed GSAP. Can you help me set up the ScrollTrigger logic for these effects? Provide the code with comments so I can adapt it to my components.

edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the horizontal scrolling example removes the only demonstration of pinning and snapping a container horizontally, which is essential for the user's gallery requirement.
Removing the snap points section eliminates all guidance on configuring snap behavior, which the user needs for the image gallery snapping to each image.
Removes scroll-synced scrubbing and replaces it with toggleActions, so the horizontal gallery animation no longer follows the scroll position, breaking the user's requirement for smooth scrubbing.
